listing.title: Game Day Saturdays | Game Day Shirt | Football Shirt | Game Day Tee | Vintage Style Tee | Retro Varsity Shirt
listing.description:
Game Day Saturdays - a vintage-inspired varsity tee with a worn-in print look.

- Soft, garment-dyed style tee, relaxed fit (size up for oversized)
- Printed to order just for you by our production partner
- The distressed texture is part of the design
- Colorway: Red And Black

Care: wash inside out, cold, hang dry to keep the print looking great.
